question: The Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita(BNSS) introduces significant changes regarding the use of technology in criminal justice. Which of these is a key technological integration mandated by Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita(BNSS)?

options.text: Mandatory use of Artificial Intelligence for investigations.
Videography of search and seizure operations and crime scenes.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Videography of search and seizure operations and crime scenes**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS)**, introduced as part of criminal justice reforms, emphasizes the integration of technology into investigative and judicial processes.
 
• A key provision under BNSS mandates **videography** of **search and seizure operations** as well as **crime scenes**. This ensures transparency, accountability, and accuracy during criminal investigations.
 
• Videography of crime scenes is intended to minimize discrepancies in evidence collection and helps maintain a reliable record that can be used during judicial proceedings.
 
• This technological integration aligns with global standards, ensuring that investigations adhere to modern practices and reduce the scope for tampering or manipulation of evidence.
 
• The provision makes it obligatory for investigating agencies to adopt videography, contributing to the overall effectiveness of law enforcement and judicial processes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Key Features of BNSS:**

 
 
• The BNSS is a modernized framework replacing the older criminal laws such as the Indian Penal Code (IPC), Criminal Procedure Code (CrPC), and the Indian Evidence Act.
 
• It incorporates provisions to enhance the use of **digital and electronic tools** for better efficiency in investigations and trials.
 
• Focuses on victim-centric justice by ensuring the protection of rights and timely resolution of cases.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Videography in Criminal Justice:**
 
 
• Videography aids in maintaining an **authentic record** of evidence collection, reducing disputes over procedural lapses.
 
• It strengthens the prosecution's ability to present evidence in court, ensuring that trials are conducted fairly.
 
• Videography also serves as a deterrent to malpractice during investigations.
 
 
 
• **International Practices:**
 
 
• Countries like **United States** and **United Kingdom** have long adopted video recording of crime scenes and evidence collection as standard practices.
 
• These practices have demonstrated improved conviction rates and greater trust in the judicial system.
 
 
 
• **Other Technological Integrations under BNSS:**
 
 
• Use of **Artificial Intelligence** and data analytics to identify crime patterns and predict criminal activities.
 
• Development of centralized databases for easier tracking of offenders and managing criminal records.
 
• Digital storage of case files to reduce dependency on physical documentation.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Artificial Intelligence in Investigations:**

 
 
• While AI offers significant potential, mandatory use for investigations is not yet feasible due to concerns related to ethical use, data security, and accessibility.
 
• BNSS does not mandate AI for investigations but encourages its adoption wherever applicable.
 
 
 
• **Robot-assisted policing:**
 
 
• This concept remains experimental globally and is not part of BNSS mandates.
 
• Robotics in policing could be considered in future reforms but is not currently integrated under BNSS.
 
 
 
• **Automated Judgment Delivery Systems:**
 
 
• Judgment automation is still under development and is not mandated by BNSS.
 
• Judicial decisions require human oversight, given their reliance on complex legal reasoning and interpretation of evidence.
